tei:div.tei:p: (143)na mo gu ru sid+dhi hūm̐: gnas bde chen rang snang 'og min zhing*/ dpal rig 'jin rgya mtsho'i tshogs dpon rje/ pha kun mkhyen bla ma chos kyi rgyal/ bus mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ gnyis snang rang sar grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ lha dngos grub stsol mjad gshin rje gshed/ grogs bar chad sel mjad mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ bu'i bar chad sol la nyams rtogs spel/ phyi snang ba dgra ru ga la lang*/ nang 'od gsal bde chen chos kyi sku/ phyogs 'jin bral bas yo nas stong*/ yongs med bral bas ro dgos med/ thams cad ye gnas chos kyi sku/ chos kyi dbyings la dgra gnyen bral/ spangs gnyen med pa chos sku'i rtsal/ bdag gzhan med pas stong pa nyid/ yo stong gnyug ma'i ye shes klong*/ thams cad thig le nyag gcig rdzogs/ phyi rol rtsal bdud rgyal 'gong rnams/ rang snang dag pa bla ma'i sku/ (144)'di la bzo re ci zhig dgos/ snang srid bde chen 'og min zhing*/ 'gro drug rdo rje gsum du rjogs/ dus gsu+um rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ spangs gnyen med par rang sar zhog re dogs med par lhur par zhog gnyis 'jin med pa bde ba che/ bde chen chos sku'i rol pa la/ bdag dang gzhan gyi chags sdang med/ spangs gnyen sdug sngal bde sdug re dogs med/ sangs rgyas sems can ming yang med/ bdud dang rgyal 'gong ye nas stong*/ lha bdud gnyis 'jin rag sar dag bcos bsgyur ma byed dgongs pa lhod/ bde sdug tshor ba nang gi bdud/ rgyal 'gong dam sri phyi yi bdud/ gnyis 'jin the tshom gsang ba'i bdud/ 'di rnams rang sar ma grol na/ sangs rgyas 'dod kyang kha thag ring*/ de phyir gnyis su mi 'jin 'tshal/ thams cad ro mnyam chen por spyod/
ces gnyis 'jin can chu skyes ming gis bla ma'i gsung bzhin rdo rje'i mchod dam pa la brjod bskul du bris pa'o//
